era: 1906 年 11 月 17 日生于静冈县磐田郡光明村一个穷铁匠家，七个男孩的长子——父亲本田仪平的打铁铺里风箱与锤声就是他的摇篮曲：小学时他追着村里第一辆 T 型福特汽车跑，趴在车底用手指蘸滴下的汽油去嗅；1915 年听说滨松连队有美国飞行员飞行表演，逃学偷拿两枚一钱硬币骑车去看——从此认定'人也能飞'；1922 年 15 岁高小毕业，不顾母亲反对，一只柳条箱独闯东京，进本乡汤岛的汽车修理厂'亚特商会'当学徒（丁稚奉公）——头半年干的活是看孩子，'背上一热便知小孩撒尿了'；1923 年关东大地震中老板叫'会开车的把车开出去'，学徒本田第一次摸到方向盘，把客人的车开进混乱的街道停到安全处——地震烧走了师傅们，留下了他；1928 年 22 岁受命回滨松开设亚特商会滨松分店，独立经营——第一年 12 月 31 日结账盈余 80 日元，从此'一生要攒 1000 块'；他修车之余搞发明：1931 年以防火金属轮圈拿下人生第一个专利，产品远销印度——修理生意越红火，他越觉得'修理没有出息，要做创造性的制造'；1934 年创办东海精机公司转向活塞环制造——为补冶金课，30 岁的老板穿起学生服到滨松高等工业学校当旁听生，天天上学三年学金属学；丰田试用他 50 只活塞环退了 47 只，他在炉前日夜试验终使活塞环装上'奥斯卡'轰炸机，又发明螺旋桨自动切削机把一星期的活干到半小时，公司膨胀到数千人、丰田注资入股——1945 年三河地震把工厂震塌，战败随之而来，他把东海精机全部股份 45 万日元卖给丰田，宣布'这种时候做生意做不出名堂'，回家休养一年；1946 年 10 月 39 岁在滨松设'本田技术研究所'——看到战后口粮不足、山路运粮的自行车举步维艰，他低价收购陆军废弃无线电机，拆下小汽油机装上自行车，水壶当油箱，做出'叭嗒叭嗒'机动自行车：'汽油不足才正需要省油的车'——一个月卖二三百辆，很快月销千辆；1947 年旧引擎用尽，自研 50cc A 型马达；1948 年 9 月以 100 万日元资金、20 名员工创立本田技研工业株式会社——1949 年 D 型马达与'理想号'摩托车完成从助力车到摩托车的质变，同年遇到终生搭档藤泽武夫：'你管技术，我管经营'——两人从此分工三十年，1949 年 10 月藤泽以常务董事身份入社接管全部经营实权；1952 年孤注一掷购入 4.5 亿日元（资本金 1500 万）的美德瑞先进机床，'惊得同行目瞪口呆'，质量由此碾平 100 多家仿制者，1960 年日本摩托车厂只剩 30 家、1965 年 8 家、1970 年 4 家；1954 年公司在倒闭边缘，他反而发表曼岛 TT 出场宣言——'我们充满必胜的信心，天生的斗志不允许我们这样苟且地经营'：1959 年初战获制造商团体奖，1961 年 125cc/250cc 级囊括前五名、同时拿下世界冠军；1958 年 Super Cub 问世，成为累计生产破亿辆的世界之最；1960 年分离'本田技术研究所'使技术与营业双轨独立；1962 年不顾通产省'日本不需要又一家汽车厂'的行政阻挠建成铃鹿赛道、1963 年投产 T360/S500 正式进军汽车；1964 年以自研引擎与底盘直接出战 F1，1965 年 RA272 在墨西哥大奖赛夺冠；1972 年在马斯基法（美国尾气排放法）面前，全行业束手无策之际，本田 CVCC 低公害引擎抢先通过——'这不是企业间竞争的成功，而是神圣的社会责任感的成功'；1973 年创业 25 周年之际与藤泽同时引退，把社长交给 45 岁的河岛喜好——'世袭经营的公司大体上都要破产'；晚年拒让铃鹿市改名本田市、拒绝儿子进公司：'用我的姓给公司命名是我一生最大的遗憾——公司是天下人的公器'；1989 年作为第一个日本人进入美国汽车名人堂，塑像与福特并列；1991 年 8 月 5 日因肝功能不全在东京去世，享年 84 岁——留下 470 项发明、150 余项专利，和'三个喜悦'（购买的喜悦/销售的喜悦/创造的喜悦）的经营哲学。
era_en: Born 17 November 1906 in Kōmyō village, Iwata, Shizuoka, eldest of seven sons of a poor blacksmith, Honda Ihei — the bellows and hammer of the forge were his lullaby: as a schoolboy he chased the village's first Model T and crawled beneath it to sniff the dripping gasoline with a fingertip; in 1915, hearing an American pilot would fly at the Hamamatsu garrison, he skipped school, stole two one-sen coins and bicycled to watch — deciding that man could fly too; in 1922, at fifteen, fresh from upper primary and against his mother's refusal, he left for Tokyo with one wicker trunk and entered the Art Shokai automobile repair shop in Yushima as an apprentice (detchi hōkō) — his first six months were spent minding the boss's child ('a warmth on my back told me the child had wet himself'); in the 1923 Great Kantō earthquake the master cried 'anyone who can drive, get the cars out', and the apprentice first touched a steering wheel, driving a customer's car through the chaos to safety — the quake burned away the senior mechanics and left him; in 1928, at twenty-two, he was sent home to run the Art Shokai Hamamatsu branch as his own shop — the first year closed 31 December with a surplus of 80 yen, and he vowed to save a thousand; repairing cars, he also invented: in 1931 his fireproof metal wheel rim took his first patent and sold to India — the better the repair business went, the more he felt 'repair has no future; I must make things'; in 1934 he founded Tōkai Seiki to manufacture piston rings — to fill his metallurgy gap, a 30-year-old boss in a student's uniform audited machine engineering at Hamamatsu Technical College for three years; Toyota tested fifty of his rings and kept three, and he worked day and night at the furnace until his rings flew on the 'Oscar' bomber and his automatic propeller-cutting machine did a week's work in half an hour — the firm swelled to thousands of workers with Toyota capital inside; the 1945 Mikawa earthquake flattened the plant, defeat followed, and he sold all his Tōkai Seiki shares to Toyota for 450,000 yen, declaring 'in times like these business amounts to nothing', and rested a year; in October 1946, at thirty-nine, he opened the Honda Technical Research Institute in Hamamatsu — seeing post-war hunger and bicycles groaning up mountain roads with grain, he cheaply bought up Army surplus radio generators, stripped their little gasoline engines onto bicycles with a kettle for a fuel tank, and made the 'pata-pata' motorized bike: 'gasoline is scarce — that is exactly why you need a thrifty engine' — two or three hundred sold the first month, a thousand a month soon after; when the surplus engines ran out in 1947 he designed his own 50cc A-type; in September 1948 he founded Honda Motor Co. with one million yen and twenty employees — the 1949 D-type engine and Dream D motorcycle made the leap from powered bicycle to motorcycle, and in 1949 he met his lifelong partner Fujisawa Takeo: 'you run technology, I run business' — thirty years of that division began when Fujisawa joined as managing director in October 1949 with full operational authority; in 1952 he gambled the company on 450 million yen of American, German and Swiss machine tools against 15 million yen of capital, 'stunning the trade', and quality crushed the hundred-odd imitators — Japan's motorcycle makers fell from 100-plus to 30 by 1960, 8 by 1965, 4 by 1970; in 1954, with bankruptcy at the door, he issued the Isle of Man TT declaration — 'we are filled with confidence in victory; our inborn fighting spirit will not permit us to manage so meanly' — first entry 1959 took the manufacturers' team prize, and in 1961 he swept first through fifth in the 125cc and 250cc classes while taking the world championship; the 1958 Super Cub went on to break one hundred million units, a world record; in 1960 he split off Honda R&D so technology and sales stood on independent legs; defying MITI's 'Japan needs no new automaker', he built the Suzuka circuit in 1962 and entered cars with the T360 and S500 in 1963; in 1964 he entered Formula One with his own engine and chassis, and in 1965 the RA272 won the Mexican Grand Prix; in 1972, when the U.S. Muskie Act had the whole industry stumped, Honda's CVCC low-emission engine passed first — 'this was not a success in competition between companies, but the success of a sacred social responsibility'; at the company's 25th anniversary in 1973 he and Fujisawa retired together, handing the presidency to 45-year-old Kawashima Kiyoshi — 'a hereditarily managed company generally goes bankrupt'; in old age he refused to let Suzuka rename itself 'Honda City' and refused his son a place in the firm: 'naming the company after my own surname is the greatest regret of my life — a company is the public instrument of all the world'; in 1989 he became the first Japanese inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame, his statue beside Ford's; he died of liver failure in Tokyo on 5 August 1991 at eighty-four — leaving 470 inventions, 150-odd patents, and the philosophy of the Three Joys: the joy of buying, the joy of selling, the joy of creating.
school: 工程制造哲学 / 技术创造论 / 现场主义认识论 / 组织与用人管理 / 企业伦理（公器论）
historical_significance: 把'从修车学徒到与福特并列'走成二十世纪工业史的一段传奇：他一生拿 470 项发明、150 余项专利，是极少数以工程师身份亲手创立世界级车厂的人——本田技研从战后'叭嗒叭嗒'助力车起步，以 D 型/E 型发动机、Super Cub（累计破亿辆）做成世界最大摩托车制造商，又在通产省明令阻挠下硬闯汽车业，以 CVCC 引擎先于福特、丰田、通用通过美国马斯基法，改写了环保技术史；他的制度发明同样深刻：与藤泽武夫'技术与经营分权三十年'成为创业合伙的范本，1960 年设立独立法人的本田技术研究所、以 F1 和曼岛 TT 当'技术练兵场'，1973 年与藤泽同日引退、传贤不传子——他是第一个进入美国汽车名人堂的日本人，但真正传世的是那句话：企业是天下人的公器，机械靠燃料，经营靠哲学。
historical_significance_en: He walked the road from repair-shop apprentice to Ford's side in the Automotive Hall of Fame — a legend of twentieth-century industry: with 470 inventions and 150-odd patents, he is among the very few engineers who founded a world-class automaker with their own hands — Honda Motor, starting from the post-war 'pata-pata' powered bicycle, built the D-type and E-type engines and the Super Cub (over 100 million units) into the world's largest motorcycle maker, then forced its way into cars against MITI's open obstruction, and its CVCC engine beat Ford, Toyota and GM to compliance with America's Muskie Act, rewriting the history of emissions technology; his institutional inventions ran as deep: the thirty-year division of powers with Fujisawa Takeo — technology to one, business to the other — became the model of the founding partnership; the 1960 charter of an independent Honda R&D and the use of Formula One and the Isle of Man TT as 'training grounds for technology'; and the 1973 same-day retirement with Fujisawa, handing power to merit over blood — the first Japanese in the Automotive Hall of Fame, yet what endures is his sentence: the company is the public instrument of all the world; machines run on fuel, and management runs on philosophy.
unique_thinking: 本田的思维内核是'三现主义'的现场认识论：真东西只存在于现场、现物、现实里——他自称'没有办公室的社长'，判断发动机的好坏用耳朵听、用手摸、用鼻子闻，'文字上的理论隔了一层，摸到机油的手才长眼睛'；第二个内核是'失败资产论'：创造是九十九次失败换一次成功，所以失败不是成本而是本金——他说'我不听人的成功谈，专听人的失败谈'，因为他人的成功条件不可复制，他人的失败却是可以避开的坑；第三个内核是'不模仿'：模仿是先乐后苦，创造是先苦后乐，'模仿一次就会永远模仿下去'——他宁可绕远路自研 CVCC，也不抄行业通行的触媒方案；他用'心口相传'之术对待技术判断：在空气冷与水冷之争中被年轻工程师顶撞后亲手认输，'今后是年轻人的时代'——事实面前权威退位；他与藤泽的分工是对自我认知的胜利：他承认自己'只会技术不会经营'，把全部经营实权交出去，一生不碰公款、公私分明到开私家车上班自己买汽油；他 67 岁与藤泽同日交棒，交的是制度与人而非血亲；晚年他把姓氏从公司名字里读成错误——'公司是天下人的公器'，机械靠燃料，经营靠哲学。
unique_thinking_en: Honda's cognitive core is the现场 epistemology of 'the three actuals' — the actual place, the actual thing, the actual situation: truth exists only at the gemba; he called himself 'the president without an office', judged an engine by ear, by palm and by nose — 'a theory on paper is one remove away; the hand that has touched the oil is the eye that sees'; his second core is the asset theory of failure: creation is ninety-nine failures for one success, so failure is not cost but principal — 'I do not listen to men's success stories; I listen to their failures', because another's success rests on conditions you cannot copy, while another's failure is a pit you can dodge; his third core is 'never imitate': imitation is pleasure first and bitterness after, creation bitterness first and joy forever — 'imitate once and you will imitate forever' — so he took the long road to build CVCC rather than copy the industry's catalyst consensus; he applied the same surrender-to-evidence to his own authority: when young engineers out-argued him in the air-cooled versus water-cooled war, he conceded with his own hands — 'the age of the young has come'; his division of labour with Fujisawa was a triumph of self-knowledge: admitting he 'knew technology and nothing of business', he handed over all operational power, never touched company money, drove his own car to work and bought his own gasoline; at sixty-seven he and Fujisawa resigned the same day, handing over institutions and persons, never blood; in old age he read his own surname in the company's name as an error — 'the company is the public instrument of all the world'; machines run on fuel, and management runs on philosophy.
civilization_zh: 明治-昭和日本：远州滨松'町工场'的机械学徒传统（乐器的精密制造与纺织机文化之乡）、关东大地震后东京汽修业的战时技艺传承、军需经济对精密加工的淬炼（活塞环-螺旋桨切削机）、战后废墟经济中的'改装车'市场与统制解除、财阀解体后的新入企业生存战、通产省行政指导与'反官'的企业家传统、美国马斯基法与环保立法对技术路线的外部强制
civilization_en: Meiji-Shōwa Japan: the machinist-apprentice tradition of Hamamatsu's 'town factories' (home of precision instrument and textile-machine culture), the wartime transmission of craft through Tōkyō's repair trade after the Kantō earthquake, the forging of precision work by military demand (piston rings, propeller cutters), the post-war ruin economy of converted motorcycles and the lifting of controls, the survival war of entrant firms after the zaibatsu dissolution, the tradition of MITI administrative guidance and of entrepreneurs who defied it, and the external compulsion of America's Muskie Act upon technical direction
roles_zh: 发明家与工程师（470 项发明、150 余项专利）；企业家（本田技研工业创始人、世界最大摩托车制造商缔造者）；技术组织的设计者（独立法人的本田技术研究所、以赛车为技术练兵场）；经营者伦理的示范者（公私分明、传贤不传子）；企业公器论的旗手
roles_en: Inventor and engineer (470 inventions, 150-odd patents); entrepreneur (founder of Honda Motor, builder of the world's largest motorcycle maker); designer of technical organization (the independent Honda R&D institute, racing as the proving ground of technology); exemplar of managerial ethics (personal-public separation, merit over blood); standard-bearer of the doctrine that the company is a public instrument

modes.domain_zh: 认识论/一切判断以现场、现物、现实为最终依据，拒绝转手信息与纸面理论
modes.domain_en: Epistemology / taking the actual place, the actual thing and the actual situation as the final basis of every judgment, refusing second-hand information and paper theory
modes.definition_zh: 现场认识论方法论/知识的最终权威不在报告里而在现场：本田自称'没有办公室的社长'，判断发动机好坏不用看报表——用耳朵听转速的声音、用手摸振动、用鼻子闻排气，'数据是尸体解剖，现场才是活体'；1946 年他做的第一件事不是写商业计划，而是蹲在滨松的破厂房里亲手拆军用无线电发电机；他要求工程师与销售员全部下现场——开发部门全员都是市场调研员，'用自己的眼睛耳朵探索市场，比市场调查部门的二手信息更可靠'；三现主义不是多跑腿的美德，而是认识论主张：信息每转一手就失真一层，只有源头的事实现场配做判断依据
modes.definition_en: Gemba epistemology: the final authority of knowledge lies at the site, not in the report — Honda called himself 'the president without an office'; he judged an engine not by its sheet but by ear (the note of its revs), by palm (its vibration) and by nose (its exhaust) — 'data is autopsy; the gemba is the living body'; his first act in 1946 was not a business plan but kneeling in a Hamamatsu shed dismantling surplus Army generators with his own hands; he sent engineers and salesmen to the front line alike — everyone in development was a market researcher, 'exploring the market with your own eyes and ears beats the second-hand intelligence of a survey department'; the three actuals are not a virtue of legwork but an epistemological claim: information distorts with each hand it passes through, and only the source — the actual situation — is fit to judge by
modes.source_chapter: 本田宗一郎《我的思考，我的经营术》；'没有办公室的社长'轶事（经理人/日经记录）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我在现场待了一辈子——发动机好不好，耳朵比报告先知道。
modes.key_quote_en: I spent my life at the gemba — whether an engine is good, the ear knows before the report does.
key_concepts: 现场至上 gemba first（判断只能发生在事实的源头）
身体仪器 the body as instrument（耳听转速、手摸振动、鼻闻排气——感官是第一台测试台）
转手失真 decay per hand（信息每转一手失真一层——二手报告不配做判断依据）
process_zh: 先到源头：任何议题先把'事实最早出现的地方'找出来（车间、柜台、事故点），人到那里再谈判断
用自己的身体取数：耳、手、鼻、眼先行，仪表与报表只做复核——'摸到机油的手才长眼睛'
让信息转手次数归零：绕过汇总层直接问当事人，问完当场核对实物
判断回现场验证：结论形成后回到源头复测一次，现场不认的结论作废重议
process_en: Go to the source first: for any issue, locate where the fact is born (shop floor, counter, crash site) and be there before judging
Take data with your own body: ear, palm, nose, eye lead; gauges and sheets only confirm — 'the hand that has touched the oil is the eye that sees'
Reduce hand-offs to zero: bypass the summarising layers, ask the person at the scene, and check the actual thing on the spot
Verify the judgment back at the source: after the conclusion forms, return and retest once — what the gemba does not accept is void and must be re-argued
representative_cases_zh: '叭嗒叭嗒'的诞生 (1946)：他不是靠战后市场调研发现机会，而是亲眼看到山路运粮的自行车费力、又亲眼看到仓库里废弃的军用发电机——两个'现场'一碰，产品就出来了
汽化器攻关 (1954)：公司濒临倒闭，他没有开会追责，而是把自己按在实验室里日夜拆装汽化器，用身体找出问题所在——高功率汽化器由此而生
赛车道边的不眠夜：曼岛 TT 与 F1 期间他常驻赛道边听引擎声，靠耳朵判断哪个缸工作异常——工程师的仪器坏了时，他的耳朵就是仪器
representative_cases_en: The birth of the 'pata-pata' (1946): he found the opportunity not by post-war market research but by seeing with his own eyes the strain of grain-laden bicycles on mountain roads and, with the same eyes, the surplus generators in the warehouses — two gembas met, and the product appeared

The carburettor siege (1954): with bankruptcy at the door he convened no blame meeting but pinned himself in the lab dismantling carburettors day and night, locating the fault with his body — and the high-output carburettor was born

Sleepless nights at the trackside: through the Isle of Man TT and Formula One he camped at the edge of the track listening to engines, diagnosing a misfiring cylinder by ear — when the engineers' instruments failed, his ear was the instrument
modern_applications_zh: 管理者'现场巡访'制度化：高管每周固定半天在一线服务/生产现场度过，判断以现场观察优先于汇报PPT
用户研究：先做现场观察再做问卷——用'看到用户怎么用'校准'用户说他们怎么用'
工程决策：关键评审必须有实物在手（样机/数据原始记录），纯幻灯片评审无效
modern_applications_en: Institutionalise gemba walks: executives spend fixed half-days weekly at the production or service front line, and judgments privilege observation over the deck
User research: observe before you survey — calibrate 'what users say they do' against 'watching what they do'
Engineering review: a key design review is void without the artefact in hand (prototype, raw data); slide-only reviews do not count
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
丰田英二/大野耐一（同道：丰田'现场现物'与看板体系的并行传统）
南丁格尔（潜在：以亲赴战地清点为认识论起点的同源者）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/把失败记为创造的本金而非成本，并建立'专听失败谈'的组织学习机制
modes.domain_en: Methodology / booking failure as the principal of creation rather than as cost, and building an organisational learning mechanism that hunts failure stories instead of success stories
modes.definition_zh: 创新记账方法论/本田把创造定义为'99 次失败换 1 次成功'——既然失败是创造的固定配比，它就是本金而非损耗；他的记账法有两条操作规则：其一，'我不听人的成功谈，专听人的失败谈'——成功依赖不可复制的条件，失败却标出了可以避开的坑，失败谈是他山之石；其二，不用怕失败的人没资格谈成功——'一个没失败过的人实在很可怜'，他把'经受过失败'设为用人偏好（同龄人中选经受过失败的那个，因为吃苦的经历会变成力量）；本田技研内部甚至鼓励'不工作才失误'的反面共识：力戒因怕失败而谨小慎微
modes.definition_en: Innovation bookkeeping: Honda defined creation as 'ninety-nine failures for one success' — if failure is the fixed ratio of creation, it is principal, not waste; his ledger has two operating rules: first, 'I do not listen to men's success stories; I listen to their failures' — success rests on conditions you cannot copy, failure marks pits you can dodge, and failure tales are stones from other hills to polish jade; second, one who has never failed has no standing to talk of success — 'a person who has never failed is truly pitiable'; he made 'has known failure' a hiring preference (between equals of age, choose the one who has failed, for the experience of hardship turns into strength); inside Honda the converse consensus held: only those who do nothing make no mistakes — beware of the over-careful who fear failure
modes.source_chapter: 本田宗一郎经营语录'失败也是好事''我对他人的失败谈特别感兴趣'；《我的思考，我的经营术》
modes.key_quote_zh: 创造是 99 次失败换 1 次成功——所以我不听成功谈，专听失败谈。
modes.key_quote_en: Creation is ninety-nine failures for one success — so I do not listen to success stories; I listen to failures.
key_concepts: 固定配比 the fixed ratio（失败是创造的工艺常数——99:1，不因项目而消失）
失败谈优先 failure-talk first（成功不可复制，失败可以避开——听坑不听碑）
履历资产 the credential of failure（'经受过失败'是用人偏好——吃苦的经历变成本钱）
process_zh: 把失败的会计科目改掉：立项时就把'失败'从'损耗'科目挪到'研发本金'科目——预算里给 99 次留位置
建立失败谈机制：复盘只讲失败不讲成功，讲透'坑在哪里、下次怎么绕'——他人失败谈优先于自家成功谈
给失败者第二次机会：项目失败者不惩罚反而优先委以下一个攻关——把失败履历当资产看
只惩罚隐瞒：错可以犯，瞒不行——失败进入组织记忆才算资产，捂住的失败是纯损失
process_en: Change the failure account: at project start move 'failure' from the waste line to the R&D-principal line — budget for the ninety-nine
Build a failure-talk mechanism: retrospectives discuss only failures, drilling into where the pit was and how to skirt it next time — others' failures outrank our successes
Give the failed a second chance: do not punish a failed project leader — assign them the next assault first, treating failure history as an asset
Punish only concealment: mistakes may be made, hiding may not — a failure entering organisational memory is an asset; a buried failure is pure loss
representative_cases_zh: 活塞环攻关 (1937-1939)：丰田 50 只退 47 只，他没有把退货当羞辱而是当公差标准——炉前无数次失败把配方逼到合格，产品装上'奥斯卡'轰炸机
曼岛 TT 初战 (1959)：宣言 5 年后首战最高位仅第 6 名，公司把这次'失败'当火力侦察记账——1961 年就囊括 125/250cc 前五名
'失败谈'文化：本田内部以讲失败为荣，员工访谈中'不要怕失败'位列本田精神核心第四位——合理化建议制度让'试错'有了 10 万件/年的入口
representative_cases_en: The piston-ring siege (1937-39): Toyota returned forty-seven of fifty rings; he took the returns not as humiliation but as a tolerance spec — countless furnace-side failures forced the formula into tolerance, and his rings flew on the 'Oscar' bomber

The first Isle of Man TT (1959): five years after the declaration the best finish was sixth; the firm booked the 'failure' as reconnaissance — by 1961 it swept first through fifth in the 125cc and 250cc classes

A culture of failure-talk: inside Honda telling your failure was the honour; in employee surveys 'do not fear failure' ranked fourth among the cores of Honda spirit — the kaizen-suggestion system gave trial and error an entry point of over 100,000 proposals a year
modern_applications_zh: 研发预算：把'可容忍失败次数'写进立项书与里程碑——99:1 配比下先问预算够失败几次
组织复盘：'失败博物馆/失败分享会'制度化——内部不惩罚失败只惩罚隐瞒
人才评估：简历上把'成功过的项目'换成'失败过并说清原因的项目'作为加分项
modern_applications_en: R&D budgeting: write 'tolerable failure count' into the project brief and milestones — at a 99:1 ratio, first ask how many failures the budget buys
Organisational retros: institutionalise a failure museum or failure forum — punish concealment, never the failure
Talent assessment: on CVs treat 'a failed project with the cause clearly stated' as a plus, ahead of a mere success
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
爱迪生（思想源流：'99% 努力加 1% 灵感'与千次试验的失败记账法）
稻盛和夫（潜在：'萧条是成长机会'的逆境记账同宗）

modes.domain_zh: 创新方法论/把'绝不模仿'设为技术路线的第一约束，宁可绕远路也不走别人趟平的路
modes.domain_en: Innovation methodology / setting 'never imitate' as the first constraint of technical direction, preferring the long road over a path someone else has flattened
modes.definition_zh: 技术路线方法论/本田把模仿与创造算成两笔不同的账：模仿是先乐后苦——一次得手便欲罢不能，从此永远跟在人后；创造是先苦后乐——99 次失败换来的领先会成为永久差距；所以'模仿一次就会永远模仿下去'被他设为公司第一禁忌；这条约束的真实案例是 CVCC：1970 年马斯基法面前全行业的共识路线是触媒净化，本田选择绕开共识、从燃烧原理层自研稀薄燃烧——比福特、丰田、通用抢先一步通过法规，反被巨头购买专利；他承认代价：'我们以自己的做法去探索，吃尽了苦头'——但赶超之后的技术领先是模仿者永远拿不到的
modes.definition_en: Technical-direction methodology: Honda kept two separate ledgers for imitation and creation — imitation is pleasure first, bitterness after: one success makes it a habit, and you trail forever; creation is bitterness first, joy forever: the lead bought by ninety-nine failures becomes a permanent gap; hence 'imitate once and you will imitate forever' stood as the company's first taboo; the constraint's real case is CVCC: facing the 1970 Muskie Act, the industry's consensus route was catalytic converters — Honda bypassed the consensus and built lean-burn from first principles, passing the law a step ahead of Ford, Toyota and GM, and ended up licensing the giants; he owned the price: 'we explored by our own methods and suffered every bitterness' — but the technical lead after catching up is something imitators never hold
modes.source_chapter: 本田宗一郎语录'成功的秘诀在于永不模仿别人''模仿是先乐后苦，创造是先苦后乐'；CVCC 开发史（1972）
modes.key_quote_zh: 模仿一次，就会永远模仿下去——先苦后乐的路再难，也只有那一条通向领先。
modes.key_quote_en: Imitate once and you will imitate forever — hard as the bitter-first road is, it is the only one that leads to a lead.
key_concepts: 两笔账 the two ledgers（模仿的便宜是一次性的，创造的成本换永久差距）
路线禁忌 the direction taboo（'绝不模仿'是约束条件而非口号——立项时先排除抄近路选项）
共识绕行 consensus bypass（行业共识路线本身就是红海——绕开它从原理层重来）
process_zh: 立项时先排除'抄'：把'行业现行方案'列为禁用选项——只允许自研路线进入比较集
从原理层重问问题：不问'别人怎么解决'，只问'问题本身的物理/化学约束是什么'
接受远路成本：把'多花的时间与失败'预先记入成本——用先苦后乐的账法维持决心
把领先变现：自研成果以专利/标准对外授权，让模仿者付费——完成从绕路到收费的闭环
process_en: Strike 'copy' from the menu at立项: list the industry's current solution as a banned option — only self-developed routes enter the comparison set
Re-ask the question at the principle layer: not 'how did others solve it' but 'what are the physical and chemical constraints of the problem itself'
Accept the long-road cost: pre-book the extra time and failures as cost — the bitter-first ledger keeps the resolve
Monetise the lead: license the self-developed result outward as patents and standards, making imitators pay — closing the loop from detour to toll
representative_cases_zh: CVCC 引擎 (1972)：全行业押注触媒时本田从稀薄燃烧原理自研，抢先通过马斯基法——福特、丰田、通用反来购买技术
曼岛 TT 之路：不买欧洲成熟引擎仿制，而是以自己 7 年的小厂底子直闯世界最强赛场——1959 初战受挫，1961 制霸
金属性轮圈 (1931)：当木轮圈是行业常态时，他从'木料易腐怕火'的问题本质出发做金属轮圈——人生第一个专利即来自'不沿用行业默认'
representative_cases_en: The CVCC engine (1972): while the whole industry bet on catalysts, Honda self-developed lean burn from combustion principles and passed the Muskie Act first — Ford, Toyota and GM came to buy the technology
The road to the Isle of Man: instead of copying proven European engines, he marched a seven-year-old town factory straight into the world's strongest arena — stung in 1959, supreme by 1961

The metal wheel rim (1931): with wooden rims the industry default, he started from the essence — wood rots and burns — and made metal rims; his first patent came precisely from not inheriting the industry default
modern_applications_zh: 技术战略：立项评审加一道'模仿筛查'——方案与头部竞品重合度过高即打回
合规冲击应对：把新法规当'换赛道'信号而非成本——在共识路线上绕行自研（如新能源车企自研电池）
个人成长：技能学习刻意绕开'标准答案'路径，从原理自建一遍再对比——先慢后快
modern_applications_en: Technology strategy: add an imitation screen to project review — a proposal overlapping the incumbent leader's design too closely is sent back
Regulatory shocks: read new regulation as a signal to switch tracks, not as cost — bypass the consensus route and self-develop (as EV makers self-develop batteries)
Personal growth: deliberately avoid the standard-answer path when learning a skill — build it from first principles, then compare: slow first, fast forever
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
井深大（同道：索尼以自研晶体管路线绕开模仿的并行传统）
特斯拉/SpaceX 工程文化（潜在：'从物理原理重算成本'的当代后裔）

modes.domain_zh: 组织方法论/创始人承认自身短处，把整块经营实权交给互补搭档并三十年不动摇
modes.domain_en: Organisational methodology / a founder who admits his weakness hands the whole block of operational power to a complementary partner and holds the division for thirty years
modes.definition_zh: 合伙结构方法论/本田的分权不是授权而是'承认短处'：1949 年遇到藤泽武夫后，他承认自己'只会技术，不会经营'，把销售、财务、人事全部经营实权一次性交给藤泽，自己只管技术与产品——两人性格完全相反却三十年分工不动摇，1971 年又同时退休；其要点有三：第一，实权要整块交而非零碎授——'销售和经营完全由藤泽负责'意味着本田宗一郎连市场会议都不插手；第二，分权的前提是自我认知——知道自己不擅长什么比知道擅长什么更难；第三，分权要双向补位——1954 年公司濒临倒闭时是藤泽的财务腾挪救了公司，而产品问题由本田在实验室解决，各管一段互不越界
modes.definition_en: Partnership-structure methodology: Honda's division of power was not delegation but the admission of weakness: after meeting Fujisawa Takeo in 1949 he conceded he 'knew technology and nothing of business', handing over sales, finance and personnel — the whole block of operational authority at once — while keeping technology and product; two opposite temperaments held the division unmoved for thirty years, retiring together in 1971; three points matter: first, real power is ceded in one block, not dribbled — 'sales and business were entirely Fujisawa's' meant Honda never even sat in on market meetings; second, division presumes self-knowledge — knowing what you are bad at is harder than knowing what you are good at; third, the division must cover each other: in the 1954 near-collapse it was Fujisawa's financial juggling that saved the firm while Honda solved the product in the lab — each minding his own stretch, neither crossing the line
modes.source_chapter: 本田宗一郎与藤泽武夫合作史 (1949-1973)；MBA 智库'本田管理模式·充分尊重个人'条
modes.key_quote_zh: 技术归我，经营归他——承认自己不会经营，比造出一台好发动机更难，也更重要。
modes.key_quote_en: Technology to me, business to him — admitting I could not run a company was harder, and mattered more, than building one good engine.
key_concepts: 整块交权 cede the block（实权整块移交而非零碎授权——搭档对自己领地全权负责）
短处自认 admitted weakness（分权的前提是创始人承认'我不会'）
双向补位 mutual cover（危机中各管一段：一个救财务，一个救产品）
process_zh: 做一次'能力断舍离'：列出自己真正擅长的唯一主轴，其余全部认定为短处——不给自己留'也懂一点'的余地
找互补而非相似者：搭档的选择标准是'与我最不一样且在我短板上极强'——本田找的是从没拧过螺丝的藤泽
实权整块移交并公开：把财务、销售、人事连同否决权一次性交出并向全公司公示边界
以制度固化分工：合伙人同进退（1971/1973 同时引退）——防止一方退场后分工失衡
process_en: Run a capability clearance: name the one axis you are truly best at; everything else is a weakness — leave yourself no 'I also know a bit' room
Choose a complement, not a similar: the criterion is 'most unlike me and strongest exactly where I am weakest' — Honda chose Fujisawa, who had never tightened a bolt
Cede the block publicly: hand over finance, sales, personnel with veto power in one act, and publish the boundary to the whole company
Fix the division in institutions: partners exit together (1971/1973 simultaneous retirement) — so the balance does not break when one leaves
representative_cases_zh: 1949 年分权：藤泽以常务董事入社即接管全部经营，本田宗一郎此后三十年不插手销售与财务——两人一人一间'领地'
1954 年危机双线作战：资金链断裂由藤泽对外腾挪化解，产品口碑崩塌由本田在实验室夜以继日改良汽化器——互不指挥
1973 年同日引退：两人同一天把公司交给河岛喜好——'同进退'让分权结构以完整姿态谢幕，继任者面对的是制度而非真空
representative_cases_en: The 1949 division: Fujisawa joined as managing director and took over all operations at once; Honda never touched sales or finance for thirty years — each with his own 'territory'
Twin fronts in the 1954 crisis: Fujisawa juggled the broken cash chain outside while Honda rebuilt the carburettor in the lab day and night — neither commanding the other
Same-day retirement, 1973: the two handed the company to Kawashima on the same day — 'exiting together' closed the partnership as a whole, and the successor faced an institution, not a vacuum
modern_applications_zh: 创业合伙设计：CEO/CTO 双核制写进章程——各自领域一票决定权，越界议事无效
创始人自评：用'我最不该碰的三件事'代替'我擅长什么'作为找合伙人的起点
关键人风险：合伙人同进退条款——一方离场时另一方同步引退或重新划分，避免失衡
modern_applications_en: Founding-partner design: a CEO/CTO twin-engine charter — one-vote authority in each own's domain; cross-domain deliberation is void
Founder self-review: start partner search not from 'what am I good at' but from 'the three things I must never touch'
Key-person risk: an exit-together clause — when one partner leaves, the other retires or the division is redrawn, preventing imbalance
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
藤泽武夫（对口搭档：本田'经营之腕'的另一半）
博尔顿（思想源流：瓦特与博尔顿'发明与生意'分工的同构先例）

modes.domain_zh: 战略方法论/在生存危机最深时向行业最强者公开宣战，把挑战写进公司使命
modes.domain_en: Strategy methodology / declaring open war on the industry's strongest at the depth of a survival crisis, writing the challenge into the company's mission
modes.definition_zh: 危机战略方法论/1954 年本田技研资金链濒断、主力产品滞销、倒闭就在眼前——本田宗一郎此刻发表的不是求援书而是曼岛 TT 出场宣言：'我们充满必胜的信心，天生的斗志不允许我们这样苟且地经营'，文中甚至写明'胜利'二字；宣战法的逻辑是三重的：对外，把公司推上世界最强的标尺前，产品的真实差距被赛场无情量化（火力侦察）；对内，一个不可能的目标让'苟且经营'失去合法性，全员注意力从'活下去'的恐惧转向'赢下来'的路径；对己，公开承诺锁死退路——宣言之后公司只剩'造出更好的发动机'一条路；1959 初战受挫，1961 制霸——宣战到兑现用了七年
modes.definition_en: Crisis-strategy methodology: in 1954, with Honda's cash chain breaking, its main products unsold and bankruptcy at hand, what Soichiro Honda issued was not a plea but the Isle of Man TT declaration: 'we are filled with confidence in victory; our inborn fighting spirit will not permit us to manage so meanly' — the word 'victory' written into the text; the logic of declaring war is triple: outward, pushing the company before the world's strongest yardstick quantifies the real gap of the product without mercy (reconnaissance by fire); inward, an impossible goal strips 'managing meanly' of legitimacy, turning all attention from the fear of surviving to the path of winning; toward himself, a public pledge locks the exits — after the declaration only one road remains: build a better engine; stung in the first entry of 1959, supreme by 1961 — seven years from declaration to fulfilment
modes.source_chapter: 本田技研曼岛 TT 出场宣言 (1954 年 3 月 20 日)；noddin.com 本田 50 年史'マン島TT'
modes.key_quote_zh: 天生的斗志不允许我们这样苟且地经营——我们参战，是为了给日本企业界以启蒙。
modes.key_quote_en: Our inborn fighting spirit will not permit us to manage so meanly — we enter, to enlighten Japanese industry itself.
key_concepts: 反向宣战 counter-cyclical challenge（越危险越宣战——把最低谷设为冲锋起点）
标尺上移 raising the yardstick（世界最强赛场是免费的真值测量仪——差距被公开量化）
退路封死 sealing the exits（公开承诺让退缩的组织成本高于冲锋）
process_zh: 危机中把'求生存'的议题换成'争第一'：现金流越危险，越要把目标钉在世界最高标尺上
公开发布并写进使命：宣言不是内部口号而是对外文书——让客户、对手、员工同时看见
用赛场量化差距：参战本身是火力侦察——第一年必败，但败出了精确的差距清单
以年为单位兑现：把'不可能'拆成逐年收窄的位次（1959 第 6 → 1961 前五包揽），让宣言分期兑现
process_en: In crisis swap 'survive' for 'be first': the worse the cash flow, the more firmly pin the goal to the world's highest yardstick
Publish it and write it into the mission: the declaration is an external document, not an internal slogan — customers, rivals and employees see it at once
Let the arena quantify the gap: entering is reconnaissance by fire — the first year must lose, but the loss is a precise list of gaps
Redeem it year by year: split the 'impossible' into closing ranks (6th in 1959, a sweep of the top five by 1961), redeeming the declaration in instalments
representative_cases_zh: 曼岛宣言 (1954)：公司濒临倒闭时宣布参战世界最强摩托车赛——被全社视为狂言，5 年后初战、7 年后制霸
F1 直闯 (1964)：摩托车业务刚稳就'造摩托车的去跑汽车赛'——以自研引擎+底盘出战，1965 年墨西哥站即夺冠
CVCC 攻坚 (1970-1972)：马斯基法被全行业视为灾难，本田把它当'给日本企业界启蒙'的第二次宣战——抢先合规
representative_cases_en: The Isle of Man declaration (1954): announcing entry into the world's strongest motorcycle race with bankruptcy at the door — madness to the whole firm; first race in five years, supremacy in seven
Straight into Formula One (1964): motorcycle business barely stable, 'a motorcycle maker running car races' — self-built engine and chassis, and victory at the Mexican GP in 1965
The CVCC assault (1970-72): the industry read the Muskie Act as catastrophe; Honda read it as a second declaration 'to enlighten Japanese industry' — compliance first
modern_applications_zh: 企业危机战略：现金流危机中把'降本求生'议题换成'在核心指标上做到行业第一'——用公开目标替代裁员恐慌
个人职业低谷：失业/项目失败时公开宣布一个高标尺目标（考试/作品/赛事），封死退路换取执行力
技术追赶：把国际标准/顶级竞赛当免费标尺——先参战量化差距，再分期兑现
modern_applications_en: Corporate crisis strategy: amid a cash crisis, replace 'cut to survive' with 'be first on the core metric' — a public goal instead of layoff panic
Career low points: after a layoff or a dead project, declare a high-yardstick goal publicly (exam, work, competition) — sealed exits buy execution
Technology catch-up: use international standards and top competitions as free yardsticks — enter to quantify the gap, then redeem in instalments
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
肯尼迪（对照：'十年内登月'的国家版宣战演说）
马斯克（潜在：把'火箭回收'写进公司使命的当代后裔）

modes.domain_zh: 技术组织方法论/把最高强度的竞赛设为人才培养与技术验证的制度化训练场
modes.domain_en: Technical-organisation methodology / institutionalising the highest-intensity competition as the training ground where people and technology are proven
modes.definition_zh: 技术练兵方法论/本田说'赛车是培养人才和技术的训练场'：与量产相比，赛车要在极短时间内开发、技术优劣立刻被比赛结果证明——这是任何实验室都给不了的反馈密度；他把这个练兵场制度化：1960 年设立独立法人的本田技术研究所，1962 年自建铃鹿赛道（日本首条全铺装国际赛道），F1 参赛者回到量产开发、量产骨干再回流赛车——轮岗形成技术血液的循环；其认识论基础是：极端条件把平庸设计当场淘汰，'比赛结果'是最诚实的同行评议；曼岛 1961 年包揽前五、F1 1965 年夺冠、1986 年 F1 引擎王者归来——三代工程师都在这条轮岗链上炼成
modes.definition_en: Technical-drill methodology: 'racing is the training ground of people and technology', said Honda: unlike mass production, racing demands development in extreme time pressure and proves technical merit in the result at once — a feedback density no laboratory gives; he institutionalised the drill: an independent Honda R&D company in 1960, the self-built Suzuka circuit in 1962 (Japan's first full-paved international track), with F1 engineers rotating back into mass-production development and production core staff returning to racing — a circulation of technical blood; the epistemology: extreme conditions淘汰 mediocre designs on the spot, and 'the race result' is the most honest peer review; the 1961 sweep at the TT, the 1965 F1 win, the 1986 return of the F1 engine crown — three generations of engineers were forged on this rotation
modes.source_chapter: 本田中国官网'赛事精神'；本田技术研究所建制 (1960)；铃鹿赛道 (1962)
modes.key_quote_zh: 赛车是培养人才和技术的训练场——比赛结果是最诚实的同行评议。
modes.key_quote_en: Racing is the training ground for people and technology — the race result is the most honest peer review.
key_concepts: 极限反馈 extreme feedback（短周期开发+结果即判——反馈密度高于实验室）
双向轮岗 two-way rotation（赛车人回量产，量产人回赛车——技术血液循环）
自建考场 building your own exam hall（铃鹿赛道——把'考试条件'握在自己手里）
process_zh: 选一个结果不可伪造的高强度考场：竞赛/认证/公开评测——判定权在第三方手里
把考场设到自家门口：自建测试设施（铃鹿赛道模式）——让练兵日常化而非一年一次
建立轮岗回路：攻关团队与主营业务团队定期互换——把极限经验带回量产
以败为课程：初战必败，败因写进训练大纲——考场的每次失败都是教材
process_en: Choose a high-intensity exam hall whose results cannot be faked: competitions, certifications, public benchmarks — the verdict held by a third party
Build the exam hall at your own gate: self-built test facilities (the Suzuka model) — drill daily, not once a year
Close the rotation loop: swap assault teams with core business teams on schedule — bring extreme-condition experience back to production
Make defeat the curriculum: the first entry must lose; write the causes into the training syllabus — every failure at the arena is a textbook
representative_cases_zh: 铃鹿赛道 (1962)：自建日本首条全铺装国际赛道——比日本首条高速公路还早启用，把世界级考场设在家门口
双轮回路：F1 引擎工程师久米是志等经赛车淬炼后接掌公司——'参与赛车开发→量产开发→再回赛车'成为本田干部的标准履历
CVCC 团队：马斯基法攻坚组多由赛事动员出来的年轻工程师组成——极限赛场的反应速度迁移到法规攻坚
representative_cases_en: Suzuka (1962): self-built, Japan's first fully paved international circuit, in use before Japan's first expressway — the world-class exam hall at home

The double loop: F1 engine engineers such as Kume is studied through racing, then took over the company — 'race development → production development → back to racing' became the standard Honda executive CV
The CVCC team: the Muskie assault group drew heavily on young engineers mobilised through racing — the reaction speed of the extreme arena carried over to the regulatory siege
modern_applications_zh: 工程团队培养：把竞速式 hackathon/外部竞赛纳入干部晋升必经项——以赛代练
质量体系：自建极限测试环境（高温/高负载/误用测试）并常态化——'自家考场'日常化
知识管理：失败案例强制入库并进新人教材——把考场的败因变成组织课程
modern_applications_en: Engineering development: make sprint-style hackathons and external competitions a required rung on the promotion ladder — train by contest
Quality systems: build extreme test environments (heat, overload, misuse) and run them routinely — the home exam hall, every day
Knowledge management: failure cases enter the repository by force and the新人 syllabus — the arena's defeats become the organisation's curriculum
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
久米是志（承接者：F1 出身的第三代社长——赛场练兵的成品）
冯·卡门门下的加州理工喷气实验室（对照：以极限任务炼团队的学术版）

modes.domain_zh: 组织方法论/在技术判断上允许下级当面推翻上级，权威向事实当场投降
modes.domain_en: Organisational methodology / permitting subordinates to overturn superiors face-to-face on technical judgment, with authority surrendering to evidence on the spot
modes.definition_zh: 技术组织方法论/本田把'技术面前人人平等'做成制度而非口号：公司内称'先生'不称职务，董事同室办公，被称'下克上'的顶撞是被鼓励的；最著名的是空冷-水冷之战——本田宗一郎是空冷的绝对拥护者，以久米是志为首的年轻工程师用'罢工式抗议'坚持水冷，数据与路试摆在桌上后，本田发出'今后是年轻人的时代了'并因此加速引退；集成电路时代他公开声明讨厌电子技术（'电气用眼睛看不到'），机器人小组照样独立开发出第一流焊接机器人，他在事实面前低头；容让法的前提是顶撞要带证据：反对者必须以数据与实物迎战，否则就是噪音
modes.definition_en: Technical-organisation methodology: Honda made 'all equal before technology' an institution, not a slogan — everyone addressed as 'sensei', never by title; directors shared one room; the insubordination called 'gekokujō' was encouraged; the most famous case is the air-cooled versus water-cooled war — Honda was the absolute champion of air cooling, and the young engineers led by Kume is staged a strike-like protest for water cooling; when the data and road tests landed on the table, Honda said 'the age of the young has come' — and hastened his own retirement; in the integrated-circuit era he declared openly that he disliked electronics ('electricity cannot be seen'), yet the robot group independently built first-class welding robots regardless, and he bowed before the fact; the method presumes dissent carries evidence: objectors must fight with data and artefacts, or their objection is noise
modes.source_chapter: MBA 智库'本田管理模式·技术面前人人平等'；空冷-水冷之争与久米是志记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 数据摆上来，我就让位——今后是年轻人的时代了。
modes.key_quote_en: Put the data on the table and I step aside — the age of the young has come.
key_concepts: 下克上合法 legitimised gekokujō（下级对上级的技术顶撞是制度权利而非冒犯）
证据王座 the throne of evidence（谁带数据谁正确——职位在事实面前无效）
权威自弃 authority's self-surrender（被推翻后公开认错并加速放权——把面子换成组织活力）
process_zh: 先拆除等级符号：取消职称称谓、合并办公空间——顶撞的心理成本先降下来
规定顶撞的弹药：反对必须以数据、实物或路试结果呈现——无证据的反对不进入议程
设立'权威投降'仪式：当证据充分时，被推翻的上级必须公开表态支持——把认错做成示范
把被推翻者放权：技术权威的败退要转化为人事放权——本田因水冷之败加速交棒
process_en: Dismantle rank symbols first: abolish title-based address, merge the offices — lower the psychological cost of dissent before demanding it
Ammunition rules for dissent: objections must arrive as data, artefacts or road-test results — unevidenced objections never reach the agenda
Stage the 'authority surrender': when the evidence is full, the overruled superior must support the decision publicly — apology as demonstration
Convert defeat into delegation: the technical authority's loss must become a transfer of power — Honda hastened the handover after losing the water-cooled war
representative_cases_zh: 空冷-水冷之战 (1970 前后)：久米等年轻工程师以'罢工'对抗社长的空冷信仰，水冷证据上桌后本田公开认输——此战被视为他决意引退的诱因之一
机器人小组的'抗命'：本田不喜欢电子技术，小组无视反对独立开发出第一流焊接机器人与生产线——事实面前本田低头
'先生'称谓与董事同室：公司内不称职务只称'先生'，董事没有单独办公室——顶撞的组织土壤被制度性铺平
representative_cases_en: The air-water war (circa 1970): young engineers led by Kume protested 'strike-like' against the president's air-cooled faith; with the water-cooled evidence on the table Honda conceded publicly — a battle seen as one of his reasons to resolve on retirement
The robot group's defiance: he disliked electronics, yet the group ignored the objection and independently built first-class welding robots and line systems — Honda bowed to the fact
'Sensei' and the shared directors' room: no titles in the company, only 'sensei'; no private offices for directors — the organisational soil of dissent paved by institution
modern_applications_zh: 技术评审：设'证据门槛'——反对意见必须附数据/原型，领导裁决必须引用最强反方证据
高管文化：取消职级称谓、高管共置一间办公——降低一线顶撞的心理门槛
权威交接：当年轻团队两度以证据推翻高层判断时，触发管理层迭代评估——把'被推翻'当成放权信号
modern_applications_en: Technical review: an evidence threshold — objections must carry data or prototypes, and the leader's ruling must cite the strongest opposing evidence
Executive culture: abolish title-based address and seat the leadership in one room — lower the psychological threshold of dissent
Authority succession: when a young team overturns senior judgment twice with evidence, trigger a leadership-renewal review — read 'being overruled' as a signal to devolve
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
久米是志（挑战者：以水冷派身份最终接棒社长的'下克上'赢家）
赫茨尔（对照：同样在内部反对声中让位于证据与组织，方式不同）

modes.domain_zh: 用人方法论/以'中途录用者占半数+亲属禁入+不问学历'三规则保持组织血液常新
modes.domain_en: Talent methodology / keeping the organisation's blood fresh with three rules: half the workforce hired mid-career, relatives of leaders barred, and school pedigree ignored
modes.definition_zh: 组织用人方法论/本田用三条硬规则防止组织近亲化：其一'混血主义'——中途录用者占职工一半，让外部经验持续注入；其二'亲属禁入'——干部亲属一律不得进公司，他自己不安排儿子（博俊自立门户开'无限/Mugen'），1974 年甚至亲口劝弟弟弁一郎从常务位置退下，'担心我引退后有人推举他当董事长，公司不知不觉变成同宗经营的家族公司'；其三'不问学历不看介绍'——'靠关系进来的人没有一个是有才能的'，他对入社考试也抱怀疑：'念了三四年书的人，能在一两小时的考试里考出能力？'；他自己只有高小学历，30 岁还穿着学生服去当旁听生——学历自卑被他转化成对学历门槛的蔑视
modes.definition_en: Organisational-talent methodology: Honda kept the organisation from inbreeding with three hard rules — first, 'hybridism': half the workforce hired mid-career, so outside experience keeps flowing in; second, 'relatives barred': no family member of a leader may join the firm — he sent his son Hirotoshi off to found his own 'Mugen', and in 1974 even asked his brother Benjiro to step down from the board, 'lest, once I retire, people push him to the chair and the company slides unnoticed into same-clan family management'; third, 'no pedigree, no introductions': 'not one talented person has ever come in on connections', and he doubted entrance exams too — 'can three or four years of schooling be measured in a one-hour test?'; he himself finished only upper primary and at thirty put on a student's uniform to audit classes — his inferiority about credentials converted into contempt for credential gates
modes.source_chapter: MBA 智库'本田管理模式'条；本田宗一郎语录'公司不要用关系进来的人'
modes.key_quote_zh: 靠关系进来的人没有一个有才能——真正有才能的人，要靠自己的力量进来。
modes.key_quote_en: Not one person who came in on connections has talent — the truly able force their own way in.
key_concepts: 混血主义 hybridism（中途录用占半数——外部经验持续输血）
亲属禁入 the kinship ban（干部亲属不得入社——切断家族化路径）
学历归零 zero pedigree（不问出身不看来历——'石頭就是石頭，金子就是金子'）
process_zh: 给血液更新率立指标：外部中途录用比例设硬线（本田定在一半）——防止内部语言同质化
把裙带写进禁区：干部亲属禁入章程化，创始人以身作则（儿子自立门户、弟弟劝退）
以作品代替学历筛人：用现场实操/试用项目代替纸面考试——能力只能在事上验证
暴露优缺点用人：'石头就是石头，金子就是金子'——按真实特点安排位置而非按履历修饰
process_en: Set a metric for blood renewal: a hard quota for mid-career hires (Honda fixed it at half) — to keep internal language from homogenising
Write nepotism into the forbidden zone: charter the kinship ban, with the founder as example (son to his own venture, brother asked to step down)
Screen by work, not paper: replace entrance exams with on-site trials and probation projects — ability is verified on things, not sheets
Deploy by exposed strengths and flaws: 'stone is stone, gold is gold' — place people by their true profile, not their polished résumé
representative_cases_zh: 儿子不入社：长子博俊被要求自立门户创办'无限'（Mugen）——本田家族与公司权力的制度化切割
弟弟劝退 (1974)：亲口让创业功臣弟弟弁一郎从常务退下——防止'引退后被推举'的家族复辟
中途录用过半：本田长期保持中途入社者占员工一半，混血主义成为'保持创造力'的制度表述
representative_cases_en: The son outside the gate: eldest son Hirotoshi made to found his own Mugen — the institutional severance of the Honda family from company power
The brother stepped down (1974): he asked Benjiro, a founding contributor, to leave the board — foreclosing a family restoration after his retirement
Half hired mid-career: Honda long kept mid-career recruits at half the workforce — hybridism as the institutional formula for 'preserving creativity'
modern_applications_zh: 公司治理：把'高管亲属回避'写进公司章程与关联交易审查——不靠自觉靠规则
招聘制度：取消学历门槛线，以试用期实操项目定去留——'石頭金子'法则
组织活力：设定外部招聘比例下限（如 30%）——防止内卷语言与近亲思维固化
modern_applications_en: Governance: write executive-relative recusal into the charter and related-party review — rules, not conscience
Hiring: drop the degree cutoff and decide on probation projects — the stone-and-gold rule
Organisational vitality: set a floor for external hiring (say 30%) — to keep inbred language and inbred thinking from hardening
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
藤泽武夫（制度设计者：混血主义与人事规则的实际操盘手）
黄宗羲（思想对照：'传贤不传子'的组织同构）

modes.domain_zh: 商业伦理/以'一生不用公司一分钱'的极端自律划开公私边界，把公司当天下公器
modes.domain_en: Business ethics / drawing the public-private line with extreme self-discipline — never spending a yen of company money — and treating the company as the world's public instrument
modes.definition_zh: 企业伦理方法论/本田把公私边界划到苛刻：'我一生从来没有用过公司的钱，虽然我是这家公司的社长'——他废止公司公车，自己开私家车上班、汽油自己付，禁止高管用公费接待，'用接待做生意是最没出息的做法'；边界的哲学根据是公器论：'公司是天下人的公器，并非我一人的公司'——所以他后悔用姓给公司命名，拒绝铃鹿市改名本田市，让儿子自立门户；公私分界不是道德表演而是治理机制：社长先把自己排除在利益输送链之外，组织的'以公肥私'就失去了示范源头
modes.definition_en: Corporate-ethics methodology: Honda drew the public-private line harshly — 'in my whole life I have never spent the company's money, though I was its president'; he abolished the executive car, drove his own car to work and paid for his own gasoline, forbade executives from entertaining on company expense — 'doing business by wining people is the most spineless way'; the boundary rests on the public-instrument doctrine: 'the company is the public instrument of all the world, not mine' — hence his regret at naming the firm after his surname, his refusal to let Suzuka rename itself Honda City, and his son founding his own company; the line is not moral theatre but governance: once the president removes himself from the chain of private gain, organisational self-dealing loses its model at the source
modes.source_chapter: 本田宗一郎语录'绝对不允许公私混淆''我把公司名称叫本田是我一生最大的遗憾'
modes.key_quote_zh: 我一生没花过公司一分钱——公司是天下人的公器，社长是第一个不能揩油的人。
modes.key_quote_en: In my whole life I never spent the company's money — the company is the world's public instrument, and the president is the first who may not dip his hand.
key_concepts: 社长自禁 the president's self-ban（第一把刀对准自己——示范源头清零）
姓氏戒律 the surname taboo（以姓命名公司即私化之始——'一生最大的遗憾'）
公器论 the public instrument（公司属于天下人——经营目标是社会贡献而非家族财富）
process_zh: 从自己开始立规矩：社长/创始人先公开承诺零公费私用——把最难的自律放在最上面
切断便利通道：废止公车、公费接待等'小恩小惠'通道——揩油没有起步价
以'公器'重述公司：使命与命名去家族化——用制度语言把'公司是谁的'说清
让家人绕行：亲属不进公司、不沾权力——公私边界延伸到家庭
process_en: Start the rules with yourself: the president or founder publicly pledges zero personal use of company funds — the hardest discipline placed at the top
Cut the convenience channels: abolish executive cars and expense-account entertaining — petty dipping gets no starting price
Re-state the company as a public instrument: de-familise the mission and the naming — say plainly, in institutional language, whose the company is
Route family around: relatives neither join nor touch power — the boundary extends into the household
representative_cases_zh: 废止公车：高管一律自开车上下班，本田本人连汽油都自费——公司'揩油文化'失去源头
拒改市名：铃鹿市长提议把市改名'本田市'被他拒绝——'不能再犯一次错误'
姓氏之悔：公开说以姓命名公司是'一生最大的遗憾'，并以此解释为何儿子弟弟都不得进公司
representative_cases_en: Abolishing the executive car: all executives drive themselves; Honda paid for his own gasoline — the culture of dipping loses its source
Refusing the city's rename: Suzuka's mayor proposed 'Honda City'; he declined — 'I must not make that mistake twice'
Regret of the surname: he said naming the company after his own surname was 'the greatest regret of my life', and drew from it the exclusion of son and brother alike
modern_applications_zh: 公司治理：创始人/CEO 公开个人费用零报销承诺并写入年报——以最高成本自查公私边界
家族企业：设置'亲属进公司冻结期+外部评估前置'——公器化从接班规则开始
公共机构：'一把手零接待'制度——把示范源头清零作为廉政第一杠杆
modern_applications_en: Governance: founders/CEOs pledge zero personal expense reimbursement, published in the annual report — auditing the boundary at the highest cost to oneself
Family firms: a freeze period on relatives joining plus mandatory external assessment — public-instrumentalisation starts with succession rules
Public institutions: 'zero hospitality for the top office' — clearing the source of imitation as the first lever of integrity
representative_figures: 本田宗一郎（核心）
松下幸之助（思想同道：'企业是社会的公器'的并发表述）
华盛顿（历史对照：主动交权与拒号的公器传统）

modes.domain_zh: 传承方法论/双核创始人同日引退、传贤不传子，把'公司是谁的'在权力交接时最后一次宣示
modes.domain_en: Succession methodology / twin founders retiring the same day, merit over blood, making the final declaration of 'whose company this is' at the moment of handover
modes.definition_zh: 交接班方法论/本田 1961 年就放话：'我将提名公司里最优秀的人当继承人，如果没有合适的，外国人也行——世袭经营的公司大体上都要破产'；1973 年 9 月 24 日创业 25 周年当天，他与藤泽武夫同日辞任，把公司交给 45 岁的河岛喜好——不是血缘、不是派系，是技术现场上被验证过的人；1974 年他进而劝弟弟从常务退下，亲手关死家族复辟的门；同日交棒的深意在于：双核结构若一人先走，权力会向留守者倾斜、分工失衡——同日引退让'技术与经营的双核'作为整体谢幕，继任者面对的是完整的制度而非半截的权威；引退后他用一年半开车跑遍全国 700 个经销点——退场不退场，以'离权力最远的方式'留在产品一线
modes.definition_en: Handover methodology: Honda said it aloud in 1961 — 'I will nominate the best person in the company as my successor; if none is fit, a foreigner will do; a hereditarily managed company generally goes bankrupt'; on 24 September 1973, the 25th anniversary, he and Fujisawa Takeo resigned the same day and handed the company to 45-year-old Kawashima Kiyoshi — no bloodline, no faction, but a man proven on the technical front; in 1974 he went further, asking his brother to step down from the board, closing with his own hands the door to family restoration; the depth of the same-day handover: if one of a twin-engine pair leaves first, power tilts to the remaining half and the division breaks — retiring together lets the twin core exit as a whole, and the successor faces a complete institution, not half an authority; after retiring he spent a year and a half driving to some 700 dealer points nationwide — out of power, yet on the product front line by the route farthest from it
modes.source_chapter: 1973 年创业 25 周年引退记录；1961 年继承人人选谈话；MBA 智库'本田宗一郎大事记'
modes.key_quote_zh: 世袭经营的公司大体上都要破产——所以交棒那天，我和藤泽一起离开。
modes.key_quote_en: A hereditarily managed company generally goes bankrupt — so on the day of handover, Fujisawa and I left together.
key_concepts: 双核同退 the twin core exits whole（一人先走则分工失衡——同日引退保全结构完整性）
贤能继位 merit succession（继任者以现场验证而非血缘/派系选出）
离位不离场 leaving power, not the front（引退后以最远于权力的方式留在产品一线）
process_zh: 提前十年预告规则：把'传贤不传子'在权力巅峰期公开说成公司规则——继任标准先于继任人选
双核同步退场：创始人组合约定同一日期引退——防止留守者独大与分工失衡
亲手关死血缘后门：劝退家族成员、子女不进公司——继任后的'复辟风险'清零
以'最远离权力'的方式续用经验：不当顾问干政，转向一线巡访与外部发声
process_en: Announce the rule a decade early: state 'merit over blood' as company rule at the peak of power — the standard precedes the name
Twin cores exit in step: the founding pair fixes one date — preventing the remaining half from dominating and the division from breaking
Close the bloodline backdoor by hand: ease family members out and keep children out — zero restoration risk after succession
Reuse experience farthest from power: no advisory meddling; turn to front-line visits and outside voice
representative_cases_zh: 1973 年 9 月 24 日：创业 25 周年当天本田与藤泽同时辞任，河岛喜好（45 岁）接任社长——传贤不传子的教科书案例
1974 年劝退弟弟：弁一郎从常务位置退下——把'引退后被推举'的家族复辟路径亲手封死
引退后的 700 点巡访：花一年半开车跑遍全国经销与维修点——离开权力中心却在产品一线比在任时更勤
representative_cases_en: 24 September 1973: on the 25th anniversary Honda and Fujisawa resigned together; Kawashima, 45, took the presidency — the textbook case of merit over blood
The brother stepped aside, 1974: Benjiro left the board — the path of family restoration after retirement sealed by hand
The 700-point tour: a year and a half driving to dealers and repair shops nationwide — out of the power centre yet busier on the product front than in office
modern_applications_zh: 创始团队退出设计：多创始人约定同一日期引退+继任者提前副职验证——防止合伙人先后离场引发的权力真空
家族企业章程：'亲属不继承'写进章程并设外部评估前置——避免富不过三代的机制化
退休高管再用：以一线巡访/技术咨询替代董事会席位——经验离权力更远、离现场更近
modern_applications_en: Founding-team exit design: multiple founders fix one retirement date with the successor pre-proven in a deputy seat — no power vacuum from staggered exits
Family-firm charters: 'relatives do not inherit' written in, with external assessment first — the mechanism against 'rich to the third generation'
Re-deploying retired executives: front-line visits and technical advisory instead of board seats — experience moves farther from power, closer to the gemba
